summary: Proposal for one Browser access and Computer access experience across engines, with target-preserving backend selection and common authority/control requirements. Separately records the current Claude-to-Station browser delivery and human-only device-control limit.
limits: Design exploration only. Cross-engine browser resolution, native harness alternatives, packaged computer control and full multi-provider execution are not implemented or qualified by this document.
checks: Read proposal against the cited current implementation and kept all proposed behavior explicitly unimplemented.
